# REQ: LANG-1871 LANG-1872 LANG-1873 LANG-1874
#- Block comment -#
class Greeter
  var name
  def init(name) self.name = name end
  def greet(times)
    for i: 1 .. times
      print(f"Hello, {self.name}!")
    end
    return 0x1F
  end
end
var g = Greeter("berry")
if g != nil && true g.greet(2) end
